articles.title_en: Russian intelligence may have hired a Turkish crime gang to set fire to a Starlink ground station in Poland, Spiegel reports
articles.lead_en: The Turkish criminal gang known as the Daltons may have been involved in the arson attack on a Starlink satellite ground station in the village of Wola Krobowska in Poland’s Masovian province, Der Spiegel reported, citing sources.
